OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements

          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32

2. Register it on the owner-body binder via `@InitBinder` in `OwnerRestControllerV1`, so it runs in the same `@Valid` pass and its errors land in the same `BindingResult`.
3. Enhance `handleMethodArgumentNotValidException` to add an `errors` array of the distinct offending field names.

content.text:
All tests pass with a clean build. Here's what I implemented to satisfy the specification.

## Summary

The requirement: reject creating an owner missing or blank in `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone`, responding **400** with a JSON body whose `errors` array lists each offending field name.

I found the endpoint (`POST /api/owners` → `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`) already ran Bean Validation via the generated `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto`, but two gaps remained:
1. The validation-error response emitted `schemaValidationErrors`, not an `errors` array.
2. `address`/`city` have only `@Size(min=1)` (no pattern), so a **whitespace-only** value ("blank") slipped through — unlike `telephone`/names, which have digit/letter patterns.

Three small, focused changes:

- **`OwnerFieldsValidator`** (new) — a Spring `Validator` with the single responsibility of enforcing the "required and non-blank" rule. It uses `StringUtils.hasText`, so it treats missing (null), empty, and whitespace-only uniformly across all five fields.

- **`OwnerRestControllerV1`** — registers the validator on the owner-body binder via `@InitBinder("ownerFieldsDto")`, so it runs inside the standard `@Valid` pass and its rejections land in the same `BindingResult`. No control flow was duplicated; it composes with the existing Bean Validation constraints.

- **`ExceptionControllerAdvice`** — the existing `MethodArgumentNotValidException` handler now also sets an `errors` property: the distinct list of offending field names from the binding result. Existing behavior (`schemaValidationErrors`, status, ProblemDetail) is untouched.

Because the custom rule and the generated `@NotNull`/`@Size` constraints can both flag the same field, the `errors` list is de-duplicated (e.g. a missing `city` yields `["city"]`, matching the test's `hasItem("city")`).

Full suite: **3 run, 0 failures, BUILD SUCCESS.**
